answer: The velvet index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 838 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the sonnet. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the zephyr queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. A farm of 28 pays that 157 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
